per_question.question: How do I define app-wide colors and text styles that widgets can reuse?
per_question.answer:
Create a ThemeData that defines a `colorScheme` and a `textTheme`, then assign it to the `theme` property of your `MaterialApp`. This makes the colors and text styles available to every widget through `Theme.of(context)`. Example:
```dart
MaterialApp(
  title: appName,
  theme: ThemeData(
    colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Colors.purple, brightness: Brightness.dark),
    textTheme: TextTheme(
      displayLarge: TextStyle(fontSize: 72, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
      titleLarge: GoogleFonts.oswald(fontSize: 30, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
      bodyMedium: GoogleFonts.merriweather(),
      displaySmall: GoogleFonts.pacifico(),
    ),
  ),
  home: const MyHomePage(title: appName),
);
```
